title: The Green Knight
text: A knight made of leaves and bark stands in the middle of the path, moss in his beard and an axe as tall as a man on his shoulder. He offers a game, courteously: strike him once, as hard as you like, and he strikes back in a year.

outcomes.text: His head rolls, and he picks it up. He says he will find you again.
He laughs, a sound like wind, and green buds break out along every scabbard. It is a joke, or a gift.
He laughs, a sound like wind, and the forest is colder to you after.

options.label: The shrewdest offers a different game.

outcomes.text: He loses a riddle and gives up his belt.
